purpose: The portable boundary between a selected owner outcome and the persistent Runtime.

authorization.rule: Only the persistent Runtime may move PREPARED to AUTHORIZED.
authorization.adapter_rule: Every external request is bound to a prepared, inactive, content-addressed delivery-adapter contract that supports the requested action and the exact delivery-policy digest.
authorization.execution_rule: Authorization is not execution; the external host must return a typed receipt bound to the same choice, policy, adapter contract, source, environment, scope, and rollback target.

privacy: runtime_ref is opaque; credentials and provider-specific values remain host-local.
